hertel-panchatantra.description: Hertel's edition of the Pañcatantra (Harvard Oriental Series): Sanskrit prose and verse in Devanagari, with margin line numbers and a running header of book and tale titles; a scan without a text layer.

ryder-gita-1929.description: A. W. Ryder's 1929 verse translation of the Bhagavad-Gita: photographed two-page spreads on a gray background, with page curvature; English stanzas, speaker headings, marginal verse numbers and italic marginal summaries.

ryder-ten-princes-1927.description: A. W. Ryder's 1927 translation of Dandin's Ten Princes, part 1: photographed two-page spreads of English prose, with running headers, page numbers, skew and curvature.
